text:
alex_csm: Quick sync 1 the NimbusCorp Dedicated bring-up is Friday. We need final confirmation on quota numbers, autoscale thresholds, and the burst test plan. Can folks confirm availability? :wave:
tara_ops: I can run the ops side. prefer early morning PST to avoid overlap with other customers. propose 07:00 PST (15:00 UTC).
sam_eng: Engineering ok. We'll validate model variants and ensure quantized fallback is wired. Need target qps/tokens for the burst.
raul_pm: Nimbus asked for conservative headroom: they want a 4x safety factor. Their telemetry suggests 20 req/s average, 120 spike. Request we test to 480 req/s equivalent or ~2.5M tokens/min. Note this impacts soft/hard quota.
alex_csm: Renewal context: they're evaluating Dedicated because of latency SLAs. If burst causes >750ms p95 we may need to show mitigation steps in QBR.
tara_ops: Suggested reserved pool: 6xA10-equivalents. Autoscale policy: scale +2 units at 70% GPU mem OR p95 > 400ms sustained 90s; scale down after 8m stability. Soft quota 2.2M tokens/min, hard cap 2.8M.
sam_eng: I'll enable prefix caching for the top 10 prompts and set batch cap to 6. Also will prepare a quantized model-micro route with 4-bit quant for fallback.
deploybot: canary-deploy: dedicated/pool-nimbus -> canary start 2026-04-02T14:30Z, status: success.
raul_pm: Burst test plan: 1) smoke 5m at 0.5x, 2) ramp 10m to 1x, 3) hold 15m at 4x target, 4) 10m cooldown. We'll record p50/p95/p99, errors per 10k, GPU util, cache hits.
alex_csm: Can we include a short A/B of fallback during the burst: 5% traffic to quantized route for 5m once autoscale triggers? helps demonstrate graceful degradation.
sam_eng: yes. We'll do 5% shadow then 5% routed, measure quality using 50 prompt checks and log ROUGE+human flags.
tara_ops: Ops checklist: set quotas, deploy autoscale policy, warm caches (run priming script), verify network egress limits, enable traces. I'll post a runbook link once ready.
raul_pm: Go/no-go criteria proposal: during 4x hold, p95 < 450ms, error rate < 1%, GPU OOM events = 0. If fail, trigger fallback and open incident channel.
alex_csm: I'll notify Nimbus and request 45m notice before test. They asked for a post-test debrief for renewal talking points.
sam_eng: Load script path: gs://redwood-loads/nimbus/burst_v3.tar.gz. Script uses 768-context, 64-token outputs, and random prompt sampling from customer set.
deploybot: perf-bot: staging smoke passed. no regressions detected in model-latency.
tara_ops: I'll schedule the window and create the incident channel. Also will set soft quota thresholds in the console now.
raul_pm: Risk note: if autoscale is delayed (API lag) and p95 breaches 600ms for >3m, we aim to cut to quantized model at 20% and re-evaluate. That will be in the runbook.
alex_csm: Action items: Alex -> confirm time with Nimbus; Tara -> set quotas, push autoscale, post runbook link; Sam -> prepare loadscript + fallback route; Raul -> finalize go/no-go.
sam_eng: I'll upload load logs to s3 and create dashboards for token/s, latencies, errors, cache hit rate.
tara_ops: Runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nimbus-dedicated-burst (draft). Posting final tomorrow AM.
alex_csm: Thanks all. Once Nimbus confirms I'll pin the run time here. :thumbsup:
